archive_units.veyport-seaweed-filer:
[Unit]
Description=Veyport lab SeaweedFS filer
After=network-online.target postgresql@16-audit.service
ConditionPathIsMountPoint=/srv/veyport
[Service]
User=veyport-seaweed
Group=veyport-seaweed
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectHome=true
PrivateDevices=true
RestrictNamespaces=true
LockPersonality=true
WorkingDirectory=/srv/veyport/config
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/sbin/veyport-archive-volume-check
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/weed filer -ip=127.0.0.1 -ip.bind=127.0.0.1 -master=127.0.0.1:9333 -port=8888 -iam=false -exposeDirectoryData=false
UMask=0077
MemorySwapMax=0
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/srv/veyport
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

audit-governance.cleanup: New COMPLIANCE versions expire 3651 days after PUT; original pre-margin synthetic versions preserve their 3650-day deadlines. S3 cannot delete retained versions before expiry. Small metadata only.
audit-governance.purpose: Small synthetic policy.* envelopes/manifests/anchor indexes and idempotency metadata (event/type/hash/manifestref); no raw payloads
audit-governance.setting_note: Prototype implementation setting for synthetic policy continuity; not a regulatory default

audit-originals.purpose: execution and original_read records; synthetic originals
audit-originals.setting_note: Prototype backend retention margin for observed whole-second defaults; application minimum remains 24 hours

limitations: LUKS manual controller unlock required after reboot

seaweedfs.data: filer fs.configure -locationPrefix=/buckets/ -fsync=true -volumeGrowthCount=1 -apply; required and persisted before qualification
seaweedfs.filesystem: REQUIRED ext4 mounted sync,nodev,nosuid; all archive services reject missing sync mount. Required because released volume writes fsync DAT but do not fsync IDX.
seaweedfs.writer_policy: Attached IAM exact S3 actions; explicit deny DeleteObject/DeleteObjectVersion/PutObjectRetention/PutObjectLegalHold; bucket default COMPLIANCE 2 days (application minimum 24 hours), governance 3651 days (application minimum 3650 days), verified exact version deadline
